items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I had engaged a French Martinique bass player named Gilbert Fanfant... The 4th of February 1957 I left Paris for Italy to do a month's tour that featured... Jack Starling, piano Gilbert Fanfant, bass

ctx.x: to replace Guy. And that gave the group a different sound with trombone in the place of a tenor.

We stayed two months in the Faun which was a record because an orchestra was never engaged to work there longer than one month. At the end of that term, we did the month of April for English troops again, and it was a pleasure to get away from the Faun after two months of working every night although we didn't have a day off during this month either; we were changing towns every day and seeing different things. Eddie de Haas Hass had left the band after we finished at the Faun and I had engaged a French…

This tour ended the 30th of April in a place called Iserlohn and we all went different places. Lily and I went to Zurich to visit our good friend Johnny Simmen and his wife Lisette. It certainly was a good feeling to get away from travelling and band leader worries for a while. But that didn't last very long and as the ball must keep rolling, when I came back to Paris, I started forming another group to go to Denmark for the month of June.
